relationships.subject: gp120 with morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: gp120M upregulated expression of cMyc (ratio of gp120M versus control, 1.68 ± 0.08 vs 1.00 ± 0.14, P = .0132) and EZH2

relationships.subject: cMyc
relationships.evidence_quote: Luciferase reporter assay demonstrated that cMyc mediated ezh2 gene transcription at the ezh2 gene promoter region

relationships.subject: EZH2
relationships.evidence_quote: H3K27me3 silenced sirt3 gene transcription at the gene promoter region

relationships.subject: GSK126
relationships.evidence_quote: GSK126 (EZH2 selective inhibitor), or recombinant Sirt3 reduced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in this gp120M pain model

relationships.subject: Sirt3
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with intrathecal antisense oligodeoxynucleotide against cMyc, GSK126 (EZH2 selective inhibitor), or recombinant Sirt3 reduced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in this gp120M pain model.

key_findings: In gp120M neuropathic pain, spinal cMyc drives EZH2 transcription, and EZH2/H3K27me3 silences sirt3
Blocking cMyc or EZH2, or supplying Sirt3, reduces allodynia and hyperalgesia
